result.justification: The study presents clear research objectives closely linked to a detailed methodology, including sample collection, processing, and analysis methods.

evidence.quote: This study aims to bridge this critical scientific gap through a two-year, multi-center investigation that systematically explores the diarrheal virus circulation pattern in wastewater.
Sampling occurred monthly from January 2023 to December 2024, spanning 24 months to obtain long-term time-series data.
Subsequently, 17.5 mL of the supernatant was subjected to viral concentration using a viral particle magnetic bead enrichment method.
The detection sensitivity and quantitative agreement between the molecular methods were thoroughly assessed.
